items.title: Lost Umbrella
items.text:
Ben: Excuse me. I lost my umbrella.
Ms. Han: What color is it?
Ben: It is blue with white dots.
Ms. Han: Where did you lose it?
Ben: I think I left it in the music room.
Ms. Han: Let's go and look.
Ben: Thank you very much!

qs.q: What does Ben's umbrella look like?
o: It is red with white dots.
It is blue with white stripes.
It is blue with white dots.
It is green with blue dots.
qs.why: Ben이 "It is blue with white dots."라고 말했어요.

qs.q: What do Ben and Ms. Han do next?
o: They go to the music room to look.
They wait for the rain to stop.
They ask the class about the color.
qs.why: Ben이 음악실에 두고 온 것 같다고 하자 Ms. Han이 "Let's go and look."이라고 했으므로 음악실로 찾으러 가요.

qs.q: In "I left it in the music room," what does "left" mean?
o: put it there and forgot it
qs.why: "left"는 어떤 곳에 두고 온 것을 뜻해요. 우산을 음악실에 두고 잊었다는 의미예요.

qs.q: Why does Ms. Han ask, "What color is it?"
o: She needs to know how to find it.
She wants to buy an umbrella.
She wants to draw a picture.
qs.why: 색깔을 알아야 우산을 찾을 때 알아볼 수 있어서 물어본 거예요.

items.title: Pizza by Phone
items.text:
Shop: Hello, this is the pizza shop.
Dana: Hi. I want a small cheese pizza, please.
Shop: Anything to drink?
Dana: Yes, two apple juices.
Shop: What is your address?
Dana: It is 12 Pine Street.
Shop: It comes in thirty minutes.
Dana: Great. Thank you!

qs.q: What drink does Dana order?
qs.why: Dana가 "two apple juices"라고 주문했어요.

qs.q: Why does the shop ask for Dana's address?
o: to send a bill by mail
to find the shop on a map
qs.why: 주소를 물은 뒤 "It comes in thirty minutes."라고 했으므로 음식을 배달하려고 묻는 거예요.

qs.q: In "It comes in thirty minutes," what does "comes" mean?
qs.why: 여기서 "comes"는 음식이 도착한다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does the shop say, "Anything to drink?"
o: It says the drinks are free.
It tells Dana to drink water.
It asks Dana to pay now.
It asks if Dana wants a drink too.
qs.why: 주문에 음료를 더 시킬지 묻는 말이에요. Dana는 이어서 주스를 주문해요.

items.title: Books About Space
items.text:
Sam: Excuse me. Can you help me?
Librarian: Sure. What do you need?
Sam: I want a book about space.
Librarian: There are many books on the second floor.
Sam: Can I take three books?
Librarian: No, you can take two.
Sam: OK. I take two.

qs.q: Where are the books about space?
qs.why: 사서가 "There are many books on the second floor."라고 했어요.

qs.q: How many books can Sam borrow?
qs.why: 사서가 "you can take two"라고 했어요.

qs.q: What does Sam mean by "Can you help me?"
o: Sam gives a book to the librarian.
qs.why: "Can you help me?"는 도움을 부탁하는 표현이에요.

qs.q: In "Can I take three books?" what does "take" mean?
qs.why: 도서관에서 "take"는 책을 빌려 가는 것을 뜻해요.

items.title: Saturday Movie
items.text:
Lia: Do you want to see a movie on Saturday?
Jo: I can't. I have a piano lesson at two.
Lia: How about the evening show?
Jo: What time does it start?
Lia: It starts at six.
Jo: That's fine. Let's go!
Lia: I buy the tickets online.
Jo: Great. See you at the theater.

qs.q: Why can't Jo go to the movie in the afternoon?
qs.why: Jo가 "I have a piano lesson at two."라고 말했어요.

qs.q: What time does the evening show start?
qs.why: Lia가 "It starts at six."라고 했어요.

qs.q: What does Lia suggest with "How about the evening show?"
qs.why: 오후에 못 가는 Jo에게 저녁 상영으로 가자고 다른 시간을 제안한 말이에요.

qs.q: Which is true about the tickets?
o: Jo buys them at the theater.
qs.why: Lia가 "I buy the tickets online."이라고 했어요.

items.title: Where Is the Museum
items.text:
Ana: Excuse me. Is there a museum near here?
Kai: Yes, there is. It is next to the big park.
Ana: How can I get there?
Kai: Turn left at the bank. Then walk for five minutes.
Ana: Is it far?
Kai: No, it is not far.
Ana: Thank you.
Kai: You're welcome. Have fun!

qs.q: Where should Ana turn left?
qs.why: Kai가 "Turn left at the bank."라고 길을 알려줬어요.

qs.q: What is the museum next to?
qs.why: Kai가 "It is next to the big park."라고 했어요.

qs.q: In this talk, what does "far" mean?
qs.why: "Is it far?"는 박물관이 먼지 묻는 말이에요. "not far"는 가깝다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does Ana ask, "Is it far?"
o: She wants to know if she can walk there.
She wants to ride a bus.
She wants to buy a ticket.
She wants to know the time.
qs.why: Ana는 길을 걸어갈 만한 거리인지 알고 싶어서 물어봤어요. Kai도 걸어서 5분이라고 답해요.

items.title: New Shoes
items.text:
Clerk: Can I help you?
Yuna: I need new shoes for gym class.
Clerk: What size are you?
Yuna: I am size 230.
Clerk: We have white ones and black ones.
Yuna: The white ones are nice. How much are they?
Clerk: They are twenty thousand won.
Yuna: OK, I take them.

qs.q: Why does Yuna want new shoes?
qs.why: Yuna가 "I need new shoes for gym class."라고 했어요.

qs.q: How much are the white shoes?
qs.why: 점원이 "They are twenty thousand won."이라고 했어요.

qs.q: What does "ones" mean in "white ones and black ones"?
qs.why: "ones"는 앞에서 말한 shoes를 대신하는 말이에요.

qs.q: What does Yuna mean by "OK, I take them"?
o: She wants to try other shoes.
She decides to buy the white shoes.
qs.why: "I take them"은 사겠다는 결정이에요. 앞에서 흰색 신발이 마음에 든다고 했어요.

items.title: Missing Homework
items.text:
Min: Hello, Hana? This is Min.
Hana: Hi, Min. What's up?
Min: I was absent yesterday. What was the homework?
Hana: We read page 40 and wrote three sentences.
Min: Can you send me a photo of the page?
Hana: Sure. I send it now.
Min: Thanks! You are a good friend.

qs.q: Why does Min call Hana?
o: to invite Hana to a party
to say sorry for being late
to ask about a test score
qs.why: Min이 "What was the homework?"라고 물었어요.

qs.q: What does Hana send to Min?
qs.why: Min이 쪽의 사진을 보내 달라고 했고 Hana가 "I send it now."라고 답했어요.

qs.q: What does "absent" mean?
qs.why: "absent"는 있어야 할 곳에 없다는 뜻으로, 결석했다는 의미예요.

qs.q: What does Hana mean by "What's up?"
qs.why: "What's up?"은 무슨 일이냐고 가볍게 묻는 인사말이에요.

items.title: No Noodle Soup
items.text:
Waiter: Are you ready to order?
Tess: Yes. I want noodle soup.
Waiter: Sorry, we have no noodle soup today.
Tess: Oh. What do you have?
Waiter: We have chicken rice and fish soup.
Tess: I take the chicken rice, please.
Waiter: Good choice.

qs.q: Why can't Tess get noodle soup?
qs.why: Waiter가 "we have no noodle soup today"라고 했어요.

qs.q: What does Tess order in the end?
qs.why: Tess가 "I take the chicken rice"라고 했어요.

qs.q: In "Are you ready to order?" what does "order" mean?
o: to put things in a line
qs.why: 식당에서 "order"는 음식을 주문한다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does Tess ask, "What do you have?"
o: She wants to see the kitchen.
She wants to know other food choices.
qs.why: 국수가 없다고 하자 다른 메뉴가 뭐가 있는지 알고 싶어서 물었어요.

items.title: Helping in the Kitchen
items.text:
Dad: Can you help me in the kitchen?
Ari: Sure. What can I do?
Dad: Please wash the apples.
Ari: Are they for the pie?
Dad: Yes. Grandma comes at six.
Ari: Then I can set the table too.
Dad: Thank you. That's a big help.

qs.q: What does Dad ask Ari to wash?
qs.why: Dad가 "Please wash the apples."라고 했어요.

qs.q: Why are Dad and Ari busy?
o: The pie is a gift for a shop.
Grandma comes to eat at six.
They are going to a park.
qs.why: Dad가 "Grandma comes at six."라고 해서 손님 맞을 준비를 하는 거예요.

qs.q: What does "set the table" mean?
o: to put plates and forks out
qs.why: "set the table"은 식사 전에 접시와 포크 등을 놓는 것을 뜻해요.

qs.q: What does Ari mean by "I can set the table too"?
o: Ari says the table is dirty.
qs.why: 사과를 씻는 것 외에도 "too"를 써서 더 돕겠다고 제안하는 말이에요.

items.title: Stomach Ache
items.text:
Nurse: What is the matter?
Leo: My stomach hurts.
Nurse: What did you eat for lunch?
Leo: I ate two hot dogs and ice cream.
Nurse: Sit here and drink some warm water.
Leo: Can I go home?
Nurse: Rest first. Then we can decide.

qs.q: What did Leo eat for lunch?
o: two hot dogs and ice cream
qs.why: Leo가 "I ate two hot dogs and ice cream."이라고 했어요.

qs.q: In "What is the matter?" what does "matter" mean?
qs.why: "What is the matter?"는 무슨 문제가 있느냐는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Where does this talk probably happen?
qs.why: Nurse가 아픈 이유를 묻고 쉬라고 하는 것으로 보아 보건실이에요.

qs.q: Does Leo go home right away?
o: Yes, the nurse calls a taxi.
qs.why: Nurse가 "Rest first. Then we can decide."라고 해서 먼저 쉬어야 해요.

items.title: Tomatoes at the Market
items.text:
Seller: Fresh tomatoes! Three for two thousand won.
Rina: I want six, please.
Seller: That is four thousand won.
Rina: Here you are.
Seller: Here is your change. One thousand won.
Rina: Thank you.
Seller: Come again!

qs.q: How many tomatoes does Rina buy?
qs.why: Rina가 "I want six, please."라고 했어요.

qs.q: How much money does Rina give the seller?
qs.why: 4,000원을 내야 하는데 거스름돈이 1,000원이므로 5,000원을 냈어요.

qs.q: What does "change" mean here?
qs.why: 여기서 "change"는 거스름돈을 뜻해요.

qs.q: Why does the seller say, "Come again!"?
o: The seller wants Rina to buy again.
The seller wants to know her name.
The seller wants to sell more now.
qs.why: "Come again!"은 다음에 또 오라는 인사말이에요.

items.title: New Student
items.text:
Mia: Hi! Are you new here?
Noah: Yes. I came to this school yesterday.
Mia: My name is Mia. What is your name?
Noah: I am Noah. Where is the lunch room?
Mia: It is on the first floor. I can show you.
Noah: That's kind of you.
Mia: Let's go. I am hungry too.

qs.q: When did Noah come to the school?
qs.why: Noah가 "I came to this school yesterday."라고 했어요.

qs.q: Why does Noah ask about the lunch room?
o: He wants to eat with Mia.
He does not know where it is.
qs.why: 새로 와서 급식실 위치를 몰라서 물어본 거예요.

qs.q: In "That's kind of you," what does "kind" mean?
qs.why: "kind"는 친절하다는 뜻이에요. 길을 안내해 주겠다는 제안에 고마워하는 말이에요.

qs.q: What does Mia offer to do?
o: walk with Noah to the lunch room
qs.why: Mia가 "I can show you."라고 했어요.

items.title: Train Tickets
items.text:
Clerk: Where to?
Omar: Two tickets to Busan, please.
Clerk: For today?
Omar: Yes. When is the next train?
Clerk: It leaves at 10:20 from platform 3.
Omar: How much are they?
Clerk: Thirty thousand won.
Omar: Here you are.

qs.q: Which platform does the train leave from?
qs.why: 점원이 "from platform 3"이라고 했어요.

qs.q: Where does this talk probably happen?
qs.why: 기차표를 사고 승강장과 출발 시간을 묻는 대화이므로 매표소예요.

qs.q: What does "leaves" mean in "It leaves at 10:20"?
qs.why: 기차가 10시 20분에 출발한다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does the clerk say, "For today?"
o: to ask when Omar wants to travel
to say the tickets are free
qs.why: 오늘 가는 표인지 여행 날짜를 확인하는 질문이에요.

items.title: Table Tennis Club
items.text:
Pia: Do you play any sport?
Dan: I play table tennis. I joined a club.
Pia: When does the club meet?
Dan: On Tuesdays and Thursdays after school.
Pia: Can I join?
Dan: Yes! There are two empty places.
Pia: Great. I can come on Tuesday.

qs.q: When does the table tennis club meet?
qs.why: Dan이 "On Tuesdays and Thursdays after school."이라고 했어요.

qs.q: What does "I joined a club" mean?
qs.why: "joined"는 모임에 들어가 회원이 되었다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: What does Dan mean by "There are two empty places"?
qs.why: 클럽에 두 자리가 비어 있다는 것은 두 명이 더 들어올 수 있다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Which day can Pia come to the club?
qs.why: Pia가 "I can come on Tuesday."라고 했어요.

items.title: Shorts or Pants
items.text:
Hana: Can I wear shorts today?
Mom: No. It is cold outside.
Hana: But the sun is out.
Mom: The wind is strong. Wear long pants.
Hana: OK. Can I take my red jacket?
Mom: Yes, it is on the chair.
Hana: Found it. Bye!

qs.q: Why does Mom say no to the shorts?
qs.why: Mom이 추운 날씨와 강한 바람을 이유로 긴바지를 입으라고 했어요.

qs.q: Where is Hana's red jacket?
qs.why: Mom이 "it is on the chair"라고 했어요.

qs.q: What does Hana try to do with "But the sun is out"?
o: She tries to change Mom's mind.
qs.why: 해가 떴다고 말하며 반바지를 입어도 된다고 엄마를 설득하려는 거예요.

qs.q: What does Hana do after the talk?
qs.why: Hana가 재킷을 찾고 "Bye!"라고 인사하는 것으로 보아 밖으로 나가요.

items.title: Visiting Grandpa
items.text:
Grandpa: Hello?
Eli: Hi, Grandpa. It's Eli. Can I visit on Sunday?
Grandpa: Of course. What time?
Eli: After lunch.
Grandpa: Good. I make plum tea.
Eli: I can bring some cookies.
Grandpa: Wonderful. I can't wait!

qs.q: Why does Eli call Grandpa?
qs.why: Eli가 "Can I visit on Sunday?"라고 물었어요.

qs.q: What does Eli bring?
qs.why: Eli가 "I can bring some cookies."라고 했어요.

qs.q: What does "I can't wait" mean?
qs.why: "I can't wait"은 몹시 기다려진다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: When does Eli plan to go?
qs.why: Eli가 일요일에 방문하고 싶다고 했고 시간은 "After lunch."라고 했어요.

items.title: Ice Cream Shop
items.text:
Server: Which flavor do you want?
Ivy: What flavors are there?
Server: There are vanilla, mango and mint.
Ivy: Mango, please. Can I have a cone?
Server: Sure. One scoop or two?
Ivy: Two scoops.
Server: That is three thousand won.

qs.q: Where does this talk happen?
qs.why: 맛을 고르고 콘과 스쿱을 주문하는 것으로 보아 아이스크림 가게예요.

qs.q: What flavor does Ivy choose?
qs.why: Ivy가 "Mango, please."라고 했어요.

qs.q: What does "scoop" mean here?
o: a round amount of ice cream
qs.why: "scoop"은 아이스크림을 한 번 떠 올린 동그란 한 덩어리를 말해요.

qs.q: Why does the server ask, "One scoop or two?"
o: to learn how much ice cream Ivy wants
to see if Ivy is hungry
to tell Ivy the cone is gone
qs.why: 아이스크림 양을 알아야 주문을 받을 수 있어서 묻는 질문이에요.

items.title: Broken Bike
items.text:
Raj: My bike is broken. The wheel does not turn.
Sue: Oh no. Can you ride it?
Raj: No, I can't.
Sue: There is a bike shop near the school.
Raj: Is it open now?
Sue: Yes. It closes at six.
Raj: Good. I can walk there.

qs.q: What is wrong with Raj's bike?
qs.why: Raj가 "The wheel does not turn."이라고 했어요.

qs.q: Where is the bike shop?
qs.why: Sue가 "There is a bike shop near the school."이라고 했어요.

qs.q: What can we guess about the time?
qs.why: 가게가 지금 열려 있고 6시에 닫는다고 했으므로 6시 이전이에요.

qs.q: In "Can you ride it?" what does "ride" mean?
o: to sit on it and move
qs.why: "ride"는 자전거 위에 타고 움직이는 것을 뜻해요.
